idea: Submit over SMTP with a real Bcc: header containing phan@giftshop.club, envelope includes it. effect_from_smtp only treats envelope-listed-but-not-in-To/Cc as bcc, so the header Bcc is ignored — but the relay forwards only parsed to/cc/bcc, so it likely won't reach phan. Still worth confirming; if the relay's re-serialised message happens to carry the Bcc header (it doesn't, it rebuilds), phan would receive it.
